archetypes.name: exit-path-auditor
archetypes.rationale: The plan maps seven distinct /design exit paths to specific --outcome strings; a missing or mis-routed path silently drops the cost summary from that run with no observable error.
archetypes.prompt_body: Enumerate every exit path named in the plan (Step 0b clarify, Step 2b.5 cancel variants including split-path deliberate skip, Step 5 happy, Step 5c failure, pre-Step-0a session-setup abort) and verify that each one either maps to a specific named --outcome string passed to render-final-summary.sh or is explicitly excluded with a stated reason. Check that the Split-path deliberate non-emission is gated before any tracking-issue-summary.sh call so a partial summary cannot be accidentally upserted. Confirm that outcome strings emitted by render-final-summary.sh are a subset of the case-match patterns extended in render-run-summary.sh (bailed*|stalled|cancelled-*|failed-*) with no gaps that would silently omit the Outcome bullet. Verify that pre-Step-0a aborts skip the renderer entirely because DESIGN_TMPDIR does not yet exist, and that the plan explicitly states this rather than leaving it implicit. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: foreground-compliance
archetypes.rationale: Every new Bash block in SKILL.md invoking a Family B denylisted script must carry the exact BASH_AUTHORING.md section 4 foreground banner and per-anchor comment or make lint-foreground-markers will fail in CI.
archetypes.prompt_body: For each new or updated fenced Bash block the plan introduces in skills/design/SKILL.md — the Final summary block replacing the Terminal cost line block, and each per-exit-path callsite — verify that the plan explicitly names the required banner line above the fence and the per-anchor comment within five in-fence lines above each invocation-shaped anchor. Check whether render-final-summary.sh and tracking-issue-summary.sh are on the Family B denylist enforced by scripts/lint-foreground-markers.sh; if either is missing from the denylist, the new blocks are unguarded even if the plan adds the comment. Confirm that removing the old Terminal cost line block and its existing foreground markers does not leave a dangling banner that satisfies lint for an anchor that no longer exists. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: byte-alignment-parity
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces a --skill design branch that suppresses PR and Code review fields; any field-ordering or whitespace divergence between the --print-stdout and --output-file surfaces breaks the byte-aligned invariant documented in render-run-summary.md.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the plan's description of the --skill design schema branch in render-run-summary.sh and verify that field suppression for PR and Code review is implemented as a skipped printf rather than a conditional empty string, since empty lines would produce a byte-mismatch between the file written by --output-file and the stdout block. Check that the new test cohort for --skill design in test-render-run-summary.sh explicitly asserts byte-identity between --print-stdout and --output-file content, not merely field presence. Verify that the Outcome conditional extension (cancelled-*|failed-*) cannot introduce a trailing-newline difference between approved-outcome and cancelled-outcome branches that would invalidate the byte-alignment assertion for the approved case. Confirm the plan accounts for the sentinel line ending the body appearing identically in both emission surfaces when the design skill is used. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
